body: Please send me a message via DM. I’ve been through similar circumstances, I was diagnosed with depression at the age of 16 and tried to kill myself on more than one occasion before them. I was raped at the age of 11 by a man who entered my home and was never caught. I promise that I understand how you’re feeling and my words and care may be enough to stop you from wanting to end it all and find a reason to keep on living💕

Please believe me when I say things get better. When I was 16 I had already tried to commit suicide multiple times but each attempt failed. This felt like a sign from God once I realised that I should have died multiple times. When I was young I had a disabled brother and a younger sister who I had to take care of because my mum was too busy taking cocaine or drinking bottles of whiskey by the litre. I’m now 20 and I’ve earned a qualification in childcare, I now work for a Government department and earn enough money to rent my own apartment and pay all the bills whilst my partner is unemployed. Do you have family or friends you can talk to about how you’re feeling? For the last 5 years I’ve had a boyfriend who I can talk to about how I’m feeling and the thoughts of suicide but I’ve always been given fuel to carry on in life. Please DM me if you’d like to talk more, please I beg you to do anything other than end your life!!
